terra.problem: The line says Paul said goodbye to the elders, but that is not stated in the supplied verses or sources. It appears later, in Acts 20:36–38.

“Paul Stops at Miletus” says Paul sails past Ephesus, while Acts 20:16 says he had decided to do so. It also says there were stops along the coast, though the passage says they sailed opposite Chios and arrived at Samos.

“Paul Calls the Elders” says chains await Paul in Jerusalem. Acts 20:22–23 says he does not know what will happen to him there; the Spirit warns that chains and afflictions await him, without specifying where.
“Repentance” may be difficult for a 5th-grade reader. Consider explaining it as turning to God.
